components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A direct action on a light project surface.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(25% 0.028 240); border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(25% 0.028 240); color: oklch(98% 0.008 90); font: 600 1rem/1.5 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button:hover { border-color: oklch(39% 0.055 155); background: oklch(39% 0.055 155); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(39% 0.055 155); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Quiet Input
components.description: A simple text field for settings and personal input.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">City<input class="ds-field" type="text" placeholder="Enter a city"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: oklch(25% 0.028 240); font: 600 0.9rem/1.4 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(83% 0.014 240); border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(94% 0.01 240); color: oklch(25% 0.028 240); font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(39% 0.055 155); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Keyboard Key
components.description: A tactile letter control in Hangman.
components.css: .ds-key { min-width: 40px; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid oklch(86% 0.014 240); border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(98% 0.008 90); color: oklch(25% 0.028 240); font: 600 1rem/1 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-key:hover { border-color: oklch(25% 0.028 240); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(39% 0.055 155); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-key:active { background: oklch(94% 0.01 240); }

components.name: Nonogram Cell
components.description: A square puzzle cell with selected and incorrect states.
components.html: <button class="ds-cell" type="button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Row 1, column 1, unmarked"></button>
components.css: .ds-cell { width: 48px; aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px solid oklch(83% 0.014 240); background: oklch(98% 0.008 90); cursor: pointer; } .ds-cell:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px oklch(39% 0.055 155); } .ds-cell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(39% 0.055 155); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-cell[aria-pressed='true'] { background: oklch(25% 0.028 240); } .ds-cell[aria-pressed='true'][aria-label$='incorrect'] { background: oklch(38% 0.035 55); }

narrative.overview: The portfolio is a collection, not a single product shell. Each project keeps its own character while sharing a quiet foundation: clear hierarchy, useful controls, and a restrained palette. The CV uses a more editorial two-column layout; the games keep attention on the puzzle; Momentum preserves its photographic backdrop and puts the clock first.
keyCharacteristics: A muted navy, warm paper, neutral gray, dark green, and brown palette.
System typography with clear scale and comfortable line spacing.
Direct feedback, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion support.
Layouts that adapt structurally instead of shrinking controls.

rules.name: The Quiet Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep accents purposeful. If removing a color does not make a state harder to understand, do not use it.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Use the system family throughout each project. Let scale and weight, not extra font families, distinguish the work.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Add a layer only when it clarifies a control or keeps content legible.

dos: Do use semantic HTML, keyboard-operable controls, and visible focus.
Do keep game instructions and state feedback adjacent to the controls they describe.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences and keep transitions between 150ms and 250ms.
Do use project imagery where it carries meaning, especially the CV portrait and Momentum backgrounds.
Do use the palette tokens as roles, not decoration.
donts: Don't add cluttered interfaces and unnecessary decoration.
Don't add excessive gradients, bright accents, and distracting effects.
Don't add overcomplicated architecture or interactions that obscure each project's purpose.
Don't use pure black or pure white for large surfaces.
Don't add decorative motion, nested cards, or colored side stripes.
